title: Indole-capped gold nanoprisms as multifunctional nano-platforms: DNA binding, mercury sensing, and biological activities.
authors: Ghosh, Amar; Panneerselvam, Murugesan; Das, Himal; Mondal, Sourav; Mohanta, Abhishek; Paria, Samaresh; Ghorui, Uday Kumar; Das, Prasanta; Das, Madhuchhanda; Goswami, Rapti; Chowdhury, Susmita; Tavares, Frederico W; Senapati, Dulal; Samanta, Amalesh; Hossain, Maidul; Chakrabortty, Sabyasachi; Sengupta, Arunima; Sur, Ujjal Kumar; Das, Suman
one_liner_zh: 该文研究金纳米棱柱与DNA的结合及汞离子传感，虽含分子对接和DFT模拟，但核心是纳米材料功能化而非TF-DNA转录结合体系，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: Binding of fluorescence nanomaterials with the most relevant biological target, DNA, has attracted considerable interest due to its potential application in biosensing and theranostics. In this study, we have reported the design and comprehensive investigation or characterization of L-tryptophan functionalized gold nanoprisms (L-Trp@GNPrs), which exhibit enhanced optical properties, such as strong plasmonic absorption, fluorescence, and Raman activity due to their unique trigonal prismatic morphology. Multi-spectroscopic, thermodynamic, imaging, and molecular docking studies revealed strong and specific interactions between L-Trp@GNPrs and CT-DNA. Additionally, L-Trp@GNPrs function as effective fluorescence and surface enhanced Raman spectroscopy (SERS)-based sensors for the selective detection of mercury ions (Hg(2+)) in aqueous media, while their surface modification can enhance biocompatibility and antioxidant and antimicrobial properties. To gain deeper mechanistic insight, quantum mechanical density functional theory (DFT) and molecular docking simulation studies were carried out, revealing that Trp undergoes notable conformational changes upon binding to gold clusters (Au(1) and Au(8)), which are stabilized by non-covalent interactions, including Au-pi, Au-NH(2), and Au-COOH contacts. NCI-RDG analysis confirmed hydrogen bonding and van der Waals interactions, with the Au(8)-Trp(4) conformer exhibiting the strongest H-bonding strength with the associated interaction energy of -6.63 kcal mol(-1). Kinetic analysis further supported these findings, indicating a fast binding rate accompanied with moderate activation energy for the L-Trp@GNPrs-DNA complex formation. Overall, the combined experimental and theoretical results have demonstrated the multi-functionality and biomedical potential of L-Trp@GNPrs in DNA-targeted sensing and therapeutic applications.
abstract_zh: 荧光纳米材料与最具相关性的生物靶标DNA的结合，因其在生物传感和治疗诊断中的潜在应用而引起了广泛关注。在本研究中，我们报道了L-色氨酸功能化金纳米棱镜（L-Trp@GNPrs）的设计及全面研究或表征，由于其独特的三棱柱形貌，这些纳米棱镜表现出增强的光学性质，如强等离子体吸收、荧光和拉曼活性。多光谱、热力学、成像和分子对接研究表明，L-Trp@GNPrs与CT-DNA之间存在强且特异性的相互作用。此外，L-Trp@GNPrs可作为有效的荧光和表面增强拉曼光谱（SERS）传感器，用于水介质中汞离子（Hg(2+)）的选择性检测，而其表面修饰可增强生物相容性以及抗氧化和抗菌性能。为获得更深入的机制见解，进行了量子力学密度泛函理论（DFT）和分子对接模拟研究，揭示Trp在与金簇（Au(1)和Au(8)）结合时发生显著构象变化，这些变化由非共价相互作用稳定，包括Au-pi、Au-NH(2)和Au-COOH接触。NCI-RDG分析确认了氢键和范德华相互作用，其中Au(8)-Trp(4)构象体表现出最强的氢键强度，相关相互作用能为-6.63 kcal mol(-1)。动力学分析进一步支持这些发现，表明L-Trp@GNPrs-DNA复合物形成具有快速结合速率和中等活化能。总体而言，实验和理论结果的结合证明了L-Trp@GNPrs在DNA靶向传感和治疗应用中的多功能性和生物医学潜力。
